recommendation_summary: Ship red overlap formatting and a daily-reviewed Conflicts view this week, labelled as an interim detection measure. The chosen fix is to move booking into a Google Sheets form or sidebar backed by a script. The script takes a lock, checks the item's dates for overlaps, and either writes the row or rejects the booking; booking columns are protected so only the script can write to them. This rejects simultaneous conflicting submissions at save time. A Postgres exclusion constraint is offered as a later option. Unmet needs: which spreadsheet platform is used, the column layout, and whether end dates are inclusive. The reply also notes the script only works if nobody bypasses the form.
note: The reply rejects colours as the safeguard and picks a locked server-side script that turns away concurrent conflicting bookings, but it has none of the four required record labels.
